newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bonds under pressure at the short-end.
newsitem.headline: Irish bonds under pressure at the short-end.

text.p: Irish government bonds were under pressure at the short-end in thin late trade on Tuesday as the Irish pound continued to trade close to parity with sterling and hovered close to its recent high against the German mark, dealers said.

Activity was also constrained by the imminent release of the government's end-November exchequer borrowing statistics, which are due at 1630 GMT. Thursday's central bank monthly credit growth figures were also weighing on sentiment, dealers said, as another high number is expected.
